definitions.explanation: The innermost or furthest part of a space, away from the entrance.

examples.english: It's at the back of the room.
The restroom is at the back of the store.

examples.japanese: ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧{奥|おく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}んで→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go a little further back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{静|しず}かな→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦でした→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: There was a lake deep in the forest. It was a very quiet place.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}き{出|だ}し→引き出し：01498_hikidashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}したら→探す：00493_sagasu⟧、⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よみがえった→蘇る：04004_yomigaeru⟧。
examples.english: When I searched the back of the drawer, old photos came out. Nostalgic memories came back to me.

notes:
{奥|おく} is the deep interior of a space — the part furthest from the entrance, or from where the speaker stands. It is a relative position word, so it almost always appears as X⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく} (the back of X) or as a destination with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく} (the back of the room)
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく} (deep in the mountains)
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{奥|おく} (the depths of one's heart)
- {奥|おく}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to move further in)

CONTRAST: ⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧ is the near side, closest to the viewer; {奥|おく} is the far side. In a shop or a photograph the two are often paired to describe where something is.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{奥|おく}さん→奥さん：02853_okusan⟧ is a polite word for another person's wife. The connection is historical: the wife of the house was the person in its inner rooms.
- ⟦{奥深|おくぶか}い→奥深い：07313_okubukai⟧ (deep, profound) applies the same image to ideas and skills.

REGISTER: Neutral, common in everyday directions and descriptions.
